title: Land, carbon and biodiversity data for supply chain impact calculation
description: Indicators of deforestation, conversion of natural ecosystems, greenhouse gas emissions, and loss of intact or high integrity ecosystems originally prepared for the LandGriffon service (https://landgriffon.com) following international standards and guidelines for reporting and target setting in the agriculture, forestry, and land use sector. Includes two layers for each indicator: impact (100m), and annualized impact per hectare of human land use (1km).
